questions.solution:
cos(90 - θ) = sin(θ)

sin(90 + θ) = cos(θ)

Substitute these values into the numerator:

4 cos(90 - θ) sin3(90 + θ) = 4 sin(θ) cos3(θ)

4 sin(90 + θ) cos3(90 - θ) = 4 cos(θ) sin3(θ)

The numerator becomes:

Factorize:

4 (sin(θ) cos3(θ) - cos(θ) sin3(θ))

Factorize further:

Use the formula a3 - b3 = (a - b)(a² + ab + b²):

4 (sin(θ) cos(θ)) (cos²(θ) - sin²(θ))

Simplify the denominator:

Denominator = cos((180 + 8θ) / 2)

Simplify:

Cos[(180 + 8θ) / 2] = cos(90 + 4θ)

Using cos(90 + x) = -sin(x):

Denominator = -sin(4θ)

Use double angle formulas:

We know:

sin(4θ) = 2 sin(2θ) cos(2θ)

cos²(θ) - sin²(θ) = cos(2θ)

sin(θ) cos(θ) = (1/2) sin(2θ)

Numerator = 4 (sin(θ) cos(θ)) (cos²(θ) - sin²(θ))

Substitute formulas:

Numerator = 4 X (1/2 sin(2θ)) X cos(2θ) = 2 sin(2θ) cos(2θ)

Numerator = sin(4θ)

Combine numerator and denominator:

Expression = sin(4θ) / -sin(4θ) = -1

questions.solution:
Factorize the left-hand side:

a3 + 3a² + 3a can be written as:

(a + 1)3 = 8.

Solve for (a + 1):

Take the cube root on both sides:

a + 1 = ∛8.

a + 1 = 2

a = 2 - 1 = 1

Effective rates of pipes under obstruction:

For Pipe 1 (5/8 of full flow):

Rate = (5/8) X (1/8) = 5/64

For Pipe 2 (3/5 of full flow):

Rate = (3/5) X (1/10) = 3/50

Total rate of work under obstruction = 5/64 + 3/50

Take LCM of 64 and 50 = 1600:

5/64 = 125/1600, and 3/50 = 96/1600

Total rate = 125/1600 + 96/1600 = 221/1600

Work done after obstruction is removed:

Full flow rate of Pipe 1 = 1/8 and Pipe 2 = 1/10:

Total rate of full flow = 1/8 + 1/10

Take LCM of 8 and 10 = 40:

1/8 = 5/40, and 1/10 = 4/40

Total rate = 5/40 + 4/40 = 9/40

Time taken after full flow began = 3 minutes.

Work done in 3 minutes = Rate X Time:

Work = (9/40) X 3 = 27/40

Work done before obstruction was removed:

Total work = 1 (full cistern).

Work done before = Total work - Work done after obstruction was removed:

Work done before = 1 - 27/40 = 13/40

Time taken before obstruction was removed:

Work = Rate X Time

Time = Work / Rate

=> (13/40) ÷ (221/1600)

Convert division into multiplication:

Time = (13/40) X (1600/221)

=> (13 X 1600) / (40 X 221) = 20800 / 8840 or 2(6/17) minutes

(sin A + cos A)2 = sin2A + cos2A + 2sin A cos A.

Since sin2A + cos2A = 1, substitute:

1 + 2sin A cos A = 1 / 8.

Solve for sin A cos A:

2sin A cos A = 1 / 8 - 1 = -7 / 8.

sin A cos A = -7 / 16.

Now find sin2Acos2A:

sin2Acos2A = (sin A cos A)2 = (-7 / 16)2 = 49 / 256.

Find sin4A + cos4A:

Use the formula:

sin4A + cos4A = (sin2A + cos2A)2 - 2sin2Acos2A.

Substitute sin2A + cos2A = 1 and sin2Acos2A = 49 / 256:

sin4A + cos4A = 12 - 2 X (49 / 256).

=> 1 - 98 / 256 = 256 / 256 - 98 / 256.

=> 158 / 256 = 79 / 128.

questions.question: If a = xcosθ + ysinθ and b = xsinθ - ycosθ, then a² + b² is equal to: यदि a = xcosθ + ysinθ तथा b = xsinθ - ycosθ है, तो a² + b² बराबर है:
questions.solution:
Square the expressions for a and b:

a2 = (xcosθ + ysinθ)2

b2 = (xsinθ - ycosθ)2

Expand a2:

a2 = (xcosθ)2 + (ysinθ)2 + 2(xcosθ)(ysinθ)

a2 = x2cos2θ + y2sin2θ + 2xycosθsinθ

Expand b2:

b2 = (xsinθ)2 + (ycosθ)2 - 2(xsinθ)(ycosθ)

b2 = x2sin2θ + y2cos2θ - 2xycosθsinθ

Add a2 and b2:

a2 + b2 = [x2cos2θ + y2sin2θ + 2xycosθsinθ] + [x2sin2θ + y2cos2θ - 2xycosθsinθ]

Combine like terms:

a2 + b2 = x2(cos2θ + sin2θ) + y2(sin2θ + cos2θ)

Note that cos2θ + sin2θ = 1:

a2 + b2 = x2(1) + y2(1)

a2 + b2 = x2 + y2
